_comment: Your standing preferences. These are the DEFAULTS the app boots with - changing anything in the app is remembered in that browser, but this file is the source of truth. Edit it directly, or ask Claude Code to.

avoid._comment: HARD no. Never suggested, never used. If a recipe needs one of these and nothing in substitutions.json can stand in, the recipe is marked blocked. Use this for allergies and genuine dislikes.

prefer_not._comment: SOFT no. The app will silently swap these for something you like better when a substitution exists, and only mention it. It never blocks a recipe. This is where 'a recipe says honey, give me stevia instead' lives.

prefer._comment: When several swaps are possible, pick from these first, in order. Group ids come from substitutions.json.

diet._comment: Filters in the app. Set any to true to hide recipes that break it.

targets._comment: Used for sorting and the nutrition badges. Purely informational.
